The structure of Li4Al4Co8O16 (reduced formula LiAlCo2O4) adopts the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Al and Co centers each coordinated by six O neighbors in octahedral motifs, while Li centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors; O centers are four-coordinate, surrounded by one Al and three Co neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Al and Co octahedra and face-sharing between Li 12-vertex polyhedra and Co octahedra.
